newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner settles dispute with News Corp.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner settles dispute with News Corp.

text.p: Time Warner Inc will put News Corp's Fox News channel on Time's cable TV system, the two companies said Wednesday, saying they had agreed to settle the dispute between them.
As part of the settlement all outstanding litigation between Time and News Corp will be discontinued as well as all litigation between Time Warner and New York City.
The terms of the settlement are confidential.
The agreement settles a dispute that started after News Corp was unable to get space on the Time Warner system.
A bitter squabble broke out between executives from the two companies, and News Corp filed a lawsuit.
The battle eventually involved New York Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, who had offered one of the city channels, but Time Warner succeeded in legally blocking that move.
